description: Manual evaluation question set for the Financial Document Intelligence Assistant. Documents tested: Apple Inc. 2025 Form 10-K, Microsoft Corp 2025 Form 10-K.

questions.question: What was Apple's total net sales in 2025?
What was Apple's net income in 2025?
What percentage of Apple's revenue came from Services?
What are the main risk factors mentioned in Apple's filing?
What was Microsoft's total revenue for fiscal year 2025?
How does Microsoft describe its cloud (Azure) business performance?
Compare total revenue between Apple and Microsoft.
questions.note: Deliberately phrased with company names to test grounding behaviour.

questions.question: What was Apple's cash and cash equivalents at year end?
questions.note: Run in comparison mode with a company name in the question, surfacing the entity-mislabelling issue.
